Class DualSparkline

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.sparkline.DualSparkline
All Implemented Interfaces:
Widget
public final class DualSparkline extends Object implements Widget
A dual sparkline widget that displays two time-series datasets as vertical bars growing in opposite directions from a shared centre axis.

The top series renders as bars growing upward from the centre; the bottom series renders as bars growing downward from the centre. Sub-pixel resolution is achieved using Unicode block characters (▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█), giving smooth visual gradation within a single character row. This layout matches the style of macOS Activity Monitor's network and disk activity graphs.

Example usage: 

DualSparkline chart = DualSparkline.builder()
        .topData(inRates)
        .bottomData(outRates)
        .topStyle(Style.EMPTY.fg(Color.GREEN))
        .bottomStyle(Style.EMPTY.fg(Color.BLUE))
        .xLabels("-60s", "-45s", "-30s", "-15s", "now")
        .block(Block.builder().borderType(BorderType.ROUNDED)
                .title(Title.from("In / Out  msg/s")).build())
        .build();

Differences from Sparkline

Feature comparison between Sparkline and DualSparkline
Sparkline DualSparkline
Series 1 2 (top + bottom)
Growth direction always upward from bottom row top grows up, bottom grows down, from a shared centre separator row
Height 1 row (fixed at bottom of area) fills the full area height
Y-axis labels optional: max at the bar row optional: max / 0 / max at top, centre, and bottom rows
X-axis labels optional label row below the bar row optional label row rendered below the chart body
BarSet yes (Sparkline.BarSet) yes (reuses Sparkline.BarSet)
